pattern: SELECT .+ FROM ([a-zA-Z]+) JOIN ([a-zA-Z]+) ON (\w+\.\w+) = (\w+\.\w+) GROUP BY \w+\.\w+
correction: Replace the GROUP BY clause with a column from the first table and adjust the SELECT clause to sum the required column

metadata.description: This rule identifies queries where the GROUP BY clause is incorrectly grouping by a foreign key instead of a primary or unique column.
